body:
STANDING RULE (Greg, 2026-11-21 ~07:59Z, verbatim via Engram::Asistant, TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #2292): „PRZEKAZ WSZYSTKIM, NIE MA RZECZNEGO HASHOWANIA”. Also #2291: „KORWA, ILE RAZY O TO PROSILEM ?? … prosze o scan i usuniecie tego gowna / jak widac dzis po comovo ile nadprogramowosc szkodzi”.

Meaning, as applied by Termal::Fable2:
- There is ONE source identity, the shared source_id from `engram source`. Git commit and diff ranges select the content.
- No code, script, review step, test or plan may compute its own hash of files, list the whole repository or index, walk directories for identity, or run environment checks as an identity.
- Remove existing parallel mechanisms; never add a replacement scanner.
- Evidence requirements (review pair, FULL, evaluation) are unchanged; only the identity changes.

Removals assigned 2026-11-21:
- raw review identity (review_identity*.rs, termal_review_identity): w-3b9de1536ccc, Sol-edfd;
- review-freeze fingerprint (scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs, a full `ls-files --stage` hash): w-b646ed9ef817, Sol-03d4, including the CLAUDE.md test-ref naming under (a), (b) and (c).

Reviewers must flag any new hashing or listing as a finding.
